subject.title: Support Azure Foundry GPT Realtime Talk via gateway relay

question: Should OpenClaw make Azure OpenAI GPT Realtime a first-class OpenAI Talk Gateway Relay path now, and what endpoint/auth contract should that path support first?
rationale: The code already has partial Azure deployment plumbing, but completing this feature requires maintainer intent on GA versus preview endpoint handling, API-key versus Entra support, safe redirect behavior, and the live-proof bar for a credential-sensitive provider path.

options.title: Keep Open For Provider-Owned Azure Relay Design
options.body: Define the endpoint/auth contract, security constraints, diagnostics, and live Azure proof requirement before implementation proceeds.

options.title: Scope API-Key GA Relay First
options.body: Accept a narrower first pass that supports API-key server-side Gateway Relay on the documented GA /openai/v1 path, leaving Entra and preview compatibility for follow-up.

options.title: Defer Until Azure Quota Is Available
options.body: Keep the issue open but pause implementation until maintainers can deploy a real Azure realtime model for end-to-end proof.

recommendation.title: Keep Open For Provider-Owned Azure Relay Design
recommendation.body: Define the endpoint/auth contract, security constraints, diagnostics, and live Azure proof requirement before implementation proceeds.

likelyOwner.reason: This person already performed the Azure account/quota live check and is connected to recent realtime provider work, making them the best current routing owner for the product/proof decision.
